improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the value proposition and free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals. The copy highlights key differentiators (Claude-powered, voice chat, trade focus) without inventing claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a professional workspace built for traders and business owners. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces the product name and its core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the low-friction entry point of three free searches with no commitment. This reduces hesitation and drives trial engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for trial users approaching the paywall. It transparently explains what happens next, reinforces value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), and highlights the affordable entry price and annual savings—reducing hesitation and encouraging conversion.
